report.title: Interchange epic 4/5 shipped; Operator MCP and the deploy gate are what stand between here and public multi-tenant.
report.subject: Research Foundry
report.scope_note: Since 2026-07-23 the platform moved fast: four of the five Interchange/Provenance/Access epic children landed on main (C1 Provenance Continuity, C2 External Interchange, C3 Catalog-Assisted Planning, C4 Knowledge MCP), Search Router P2+P3 and the Rights/Evidence entity model and Claim Term Indexing all shipped, and the rf CLI was decoupled from the serve extra. What remains: Operator MCP (C5, P1 owner-accepted, P2-P6 open), the DI-1 deploy gate (delta re-audit remediated but still BLOCKED), a large idea/shaping design-spec backlog spun off as epic deferrals, and offline-built integrations awaiting first live validation. Trackers and design-spec frontmatter lag git — this report reconciles against commits, not the ITT node states.
report.constraints: Files are canonical; DBs are derived. Loopback-only; never exfiltrate. No model call on the read/render path. agent-writable paths can never mint CLEARED_*/counsel_approved/attested rights values (no_agent_cleared_rights_value). Always re-run authoritative `rf verify` — never trust a workflow's bundle_ok. Commit + squash-merge on completion; push before deploy. Mode-D diffs (auth/secrets/deletion/migrations) must be cross-model adversarially verified before merge.
